summary: Executed full backend pytest regression plus focused frontend e2e for new non-generative layers studio scope, background removal, admin CRUD, and checkout flow.

ui_bugs.issue: After archive -> edit -> set active=true -> save, UI status label stayed 'Archiviert' in one run although backend product state was active=true (possible stale list refresh/race).

integration_issues.flow: Initial studio load for fresh guest sessions
integration_issues.issue: Public /gestalten can render rate-limit blocker ('Zu viele neue Gastzugänge...') before editor loads under shared preview traffic.

action_items: Investigate AdminProductsPage post-save reload/state update for reactivation path; ensure status chip refreshes deterministically.
Tune guest session limiter behavior for shared-ingress preview traffic so valid users are less likely to hit immediate 429 on first load.
Optional cleanup: remove stale assistant-related CSS/dead styles now that assistant UI/API are retired.
critical_code_review_comments: Retired AI scope is enforced at API level: /api/studio/quota and /api/studio/drafts/{id}/preview now return 404 in regression tests.
Assistant endpoints are retired and covered by explicit 404 tests, but file names still contain legacy 'assistant' naming and one skipped Gemini test remains in suite.
Layer validation rules are strict and verified (<=12 elements, unique ids, hidden-only invalid, font allowlist, ownership checks in save flow).

success_rate.backend: 100% pass on active tests (32 passed, 1 skipped legacy real-AI test)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (core studio layering/upload/crop/background-removal/save/cart/checkout/order passed; one admin reactivation UI inconsistency observed once)

seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST guest JWT sessions and multiple TEST admin products via UI/API during CRUD runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Studio e2e is runnable by seeding localStorage key 'manucreator-studio-guest-v1' in preview to avoid shared-IP session limit noise. Product id 03417c1b-cb16-4141-9b13-f3c9763b5f33 (TEST UI PROD...) is active in DB; backend API confirms active=true/version=4.
rca of the issue: Admin reactivation mismatch RCA: UI run showed 'Archiviert' immediately after save, but direct API verification for same product id returned active=true. This points to frontend list refresh/state timing rather than backend persistence failure. For guest-load blocker: repeated /api/studio/session from shared preview ingress reaches limiter and prevents initial editor boot for new sessions.
